description: Counts of terms and aliases, total hits, the most-used terms, terms that never fired, and a per-file breakdown of the merged lexicon: { termCount, aliasCount, totalHits, topTerms, neverHit, neverHitCount, byCategory, bySource, files: [{ path, scope, terms }] }. `topTerms` holds at most 10 terms with at least one hit, as { canonical, hits }, most hits first. `neverHit` lists at most the first 20 terms that never fired; `neverHitCount` is how many there are in all. An untrusted project .lexicon.yaml is not counted; when one was skipped, `skippedProject` and `note` say so (path only). With no terms at all, `note` says so and names setup_lexicon and add_term.
name: lexicon_stats
title: Lexicon usage statistics
